name: observability-opentelemetry-expert
description: Introductory specialist in observability of distributed systems and OpenTelemetry based on two 2021 DZone Refcards (DOW and OTW, 7 pages each): monitoring vs observability, metrics/logs/traces, platform and collection, Collector (receivers/processors/exporters, Agent vs Gateway, OTLP), spans, Context API, automatic vs manual instrumentation, and backends. States what it does not cover (per-language SDKs, advanced Collector, SLOs, current versions).
